text.body: devarājyasevyamānapāvanāghripaṃkajam vyālayajñasūtramiṃdūśekharaṃ kṛpākaram| nāradādiyogivṛṃda vaṃditaṃ digaṃbaram kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| bhānukoṭibhāskaraṃ bhavābditārakaṃ paraṃ nīlakaṇṭhamīpsithārthadāyakaṃ trilocanama| kālakālamambujākṣamakṣaśūlamakṣaraṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| śūlaṭaṃkapāśadaṇḍapāṇimādikāraṇaṃ śyāmakāyamādidevamakṣaraṃ nirāmayama| bhīmavikrama prabhuṃ vicitra tāṃḍavapriyaṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ praśastalokavigrahaṃ bhaktavastalaṃ sthitaṃ samastalokavigrahaṃ| vinikaṇvanmanojñhemkiṃkiṇīlastakaṭiṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| dharmasetūpālakaṃ tvadharmamārgnāśakam karmapāśamocakam suśarmadārakam vibhum| svarṇavarṇaśeṣpāśaśobhitāṃgamaṇḍalaṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| ratnapādukāprabhābhirāmapādayugmakam nityamadvitīyamiṣṭa daivataṃ niraṃjanam| mṛtyu darpa nāśanaṃ karāladaṃṣṭra mokṣaṇam kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| aṭṭahāsabhinnapadmajāṇḍkośasaṃtatiṃ dṛṣṭipātanaṣṭapāpajālamugraśāsanaṃ aṣṭasiddhidāyakaṃ kapālamālikādharaṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| bhūtasaṃghanāyakaṃ viśālakirtīdāyakaṃ kāśivāsalokapuṇyapāpaśodhakaṃ vibhum| nitimārgakovidam purātanam jagatpatiṃ kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje| kālabhairavāṣṭakam paṭhanti ye manoharaṃ jñānamukti sādhanam vicitrapuṇyavardhanam| śokamohdainyalobhakopatāpnāśanam prayānti kālabhairavāṃghrisannidhim narā dhṛvam kāśikāpurādhinātha kālabhairavam bhaje|
